title: CAPIT Privacy Policy
description: What information CAPIT collects, how it is used and shared, and what happens when you browse, contact us, or connect a wallet.
headline: Privacy Policy
body:
Last updated: September 2026.

This Privacy Policy explains how Tellus Digital, LLC ("we" or "us"), which operates CAPIT, collects, uses, shares, and retains information when you visit the site, contact us, connect a wallet, or use embedded third-party services.

sections.heading: Information You Give Us
sections.body: When you contact us, we collect what you choose to send, such as your name, email address, organization, and message.

sections.heading: Information Collected Automatically
sections.body: Our hosting and analytics providers may automatically collect technical data such as browser type, device type, approximate location based on IP address, pages visited, and referring URLs. We use this to keep the site secure, fix problems, and understand how the site is used.

sections.heading: Wallet and Blockchain Data
sections.body: If you connect a wallet, the site receives your public wallet address and network details so it can display balances and prepare transactions. Blockchain transactions are public and permanent; we cannot change or delete information recorded on a blockchain. CAPIT never asks for or stores private keys, recovery phrases, or wallet passwords.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
bullets: Operate, secure, and improve the site
Respond to your questions, correction requests, and legal notices
Detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and security incidents

sections.heading: How We Share Information
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We share information only with service providers that help us run the site (such as hosting, analytics, and wallet-connection services), when required by law, to protect rights and safety, or as part of a business transfer such as a merger or acquisition.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: Wallet apps, wallet-connection services, decentralized exchanges, and block explorers linked from CAPIT are run by third parties under their own privacy policies. We are not responsible for how they handle your information.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: We keep contact messages and technical data only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law.

sections.heading: Your Choices
sections.body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information we hold about you. Send requests through the [Contact](/contact) page and choose Privacy Request.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: CAPIT is not directed to anyone under 18, and we do not knowingly collect information from children.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of the page shows when it last changed.
